purpose: Manifest the missing input needed to replay the persisted v2 external580 evaluation without inventing or reconstructing examples.
minimum_recovery_package: The immutable JSONL case inputs, including issue context and gold label, with the recorded SHA-256.
A provenance and rights note for each source or a documented aggregation policy.
A versioned scoring schema that defines real error, false alert, cancellation and protocol retention.
A separate reviewer rationale for unsafe withdrawals when the original workbook cannot be retained.
do_not_do: Do not synthesize a replacement corpus and call it external580.
Do not infer missing inputs from model responses or withdrawal scores.
Do not overwrite the historical response, score or unsafe-withdrawal artifacts.
